subject: 📝 Accommodation Application Submitted - Reference #$application_id
body:
Dear $student_name,

Your application for university accommodation has been SUBMITTED successfully and is now waiting to be reviewed.

=== WHAT YOU SUBMITTED ===
Reference Number: $application_id
Student ID: $student_id
Submitted On: $submission_date
Submitted By: $submitted_by

Preferred Building: $preferred_building
Preferred Room Type: $preferred_room_type
Requested Move-In Date: $move_in_date
Requested Duration: $duration_months months
Estimated End Date: $end_date
Special Requirements: $special_requirements

Current Status: $status

=== PLEASE CHECK THESE DETAILS ===
If anything above is wrong, contact the Housing Office before your application is reviewed. Submitting a second application will replace this one rather than sit alongside it — you can only hold one open accommodation application at a time.

=== WHAT HAPPENS NEXT ===
1. Housing Administration will review your application.
2. We may contact you if we need more information.
3. You will receive an email with the outcome of your application.
4. If you are offered a room, that email will include the building, room number and floor number.

Typical review time is 5-7 working days.

=== CONTACT INFORMATION ===
Housing Office: housing@university.edu
Phone: (555) 123-4567
Office Hours: Monday-Friday, 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM

Thank you for applying.

Best regards,
University Housing Administration

$signature
